purpose: Restore existing first-party Cloudflare Web Analytics to the approved Physics Explorer without changing layout or private-data behavior

operations.beforeText: Source-aware scientific exploration. Reviewed metadata does not establish experimental confirmation or exhaust all research.
operations.afterText: Source-aware scientific exploration. Reviewed metadata does not establish experimental confirmation or exhaust all research. On quantumindex.site, cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics measures visits and page performance; it does not read private notes or search text.
